description: This file implements shared memory and CUDA IPC (Inter-Process Communication) mechanisms for PyTorch storage objects, including functions for creating shared storage, sharing CUDA tensors, managing reference counts, and exposing these functionalities via Python bindings.

methods.name: THPStorage_sharedDecref
methods.description: Decrements reference count for shared CPU storage in shared memory.

methods.name: THPStorage_sharedIncref
methods.description: Increments reference count for shared CPU storage in shared memory.

methods.name: THPStorage_pyNewFilenameStorage
methods.description: Creates a new shared storage object backed by a filename in shared memory.

methods.name: THPStorage_shareFilename
methods.description: Shares a CPU storage object via a filename in shared memory, returning handles.

methods.name: THPStorage_newSharedFilename
methods.description: Creates a new shared storage object from provided filename handle and size.

methods.name: THPStorage_pyNewFdStorage
methods.description: Creates a shared storage object backed by a file descriptor.

methods.name: THPStorage_shareFd
methods.description: Shares a CPU storage object via a file descriptor.

methods.name: THPStorage_newSharedFd
methods.description: Creates a new shared storage object from a file descriptor and size.

methods.name: THPStorage_shareCuda
methods.description: Shares a CUDA tensor via IPC handle, returning metadata for IPC sharing.

methods.name: THPStorage_newSharedCuda
methods.description: Creates a CUDA storage object from IPC handle data for shared CUDA tensors.

methods.name: THPStorage_weakRef
methods.description: Returns a weak reference (pointer) to the storage implementation.

methods.name: THPStorage_newWithWeakPtr
methods.description: Creates a storage object from a weak pointer.

methods.name: THPStorage_freeWeakRef
methods.description: Decrements the weak reference count for a storage weak pointer.

methods.name: THPStorage_expired
methods.description: Checks if a weak reference to storage has expired (no longer valid).

methods.name: THPStorage_sharedFd
methods.description: Retrieves the shared file descriptor for a CPU storage object.

methods.name: THPStorage_isShared
methods.description: Checks if a storage object is shared via shared memory or CUDA IPC.
